forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: ffe080
+title: Retire the cognitive-complexity scorer in swissarmyhammer-sem, or split test_census off it
+---
+`^z2r1psf` took the complexity gate away from every language: the five `complexity-<lang>` tool rules, the `cognitive-complexity` prompt rule and the `complexity` PROBE are gone. The scorer the probe called is still in the tree with no consumer.
+
+## What is left, and why it stayed
+
+`crates/swissarmyhammer-sem/src/parser/plugins/code/complexity.rs` — 2257 lines — plus its 13-language test tree under `complexity/tests/`. Its public surface is `cognitive_complexity`, `FileComplexity`, `FunctionComplexity`, `COGNITIVE_COMPLEXITY_THRESHOLD` and `NESTING_DEPTH_THRESHOLD`. After `^z2r1psf` NOTHING in the workspace calls any of the five.
+
+It stayed because the file is not one thing. `complexity/test_census.rs` — 756 lines — stands in the same module and HAS a live consumer: `review/tree_sitter_probes.rs` drives it for the `suspect_test` probe, which `test-integrity` declares and which that card does not touch. And `test_census.rs` is built ON the scorer's machinery. It imports eight items from `complexity.rs`:
+
+    use super::{
+        child_by_field_or_kind, for_each_function, function_header, function_name,
+        is_test_definition, node_text, spec_for_language, ComplexitySpec,
+        MAX_TRAVERSAL_DEPTH,
+    };
+
+`ComplexitySpec` and `spec_for_language` are the per-language node tables, and `for_each_function`, `function_header`, `function_name` and `is_test_definition` are the traversal. So the shared half is most of what makes the file long, and a plain deletion does not compile.
+
+## What to do
+
+Split the file, then delete what no longer has a caller.
+
+1. Move the shared traversal and the per-language spec table into a module of their own — `code/function_walk.rs` is one name for it — and have `test_census.rs` import from there.
+2. Delete the SCORING half: the score walk, the two thresholds, `FileComplexity`, `FunctionComplexity`, `cognitive_complexity`, `exceeds_gates`, and the re-exports in `code/mod.rs`.
+3. Delete the score tests under `complexity/tests/` and keep every test that reads the shared walk, re-pointed at its new module.
+4. `cargo nextest run --workspace` green, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
+
+## Why it matters
+
+A 2257-line scorer nobody calls is dead code that reads as live, and `code/mod.rs` still documents it as "Cognitive complexity computed from the parse, so a reviewer compares numbers instead of counting nesting by eye" — a sentence that names a reviewer who no longer exists.
+
+#tool-validators
\ No newline at end of file
